send in verb

also let in, let loose (on), send against, launch, throw into

classical

Caes. BG 7.40.4: equitātū immissō (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 40.40.5: sī effrēnātōs in eōs equōs immittitis (Lewis & Short)

immittō, immittere, immīsī, immissum

verb, third conjugation

send in, let in; send or let loose against; throw into

Examples

  • sī effrēnātōs in eōs equōs immittitis

    if you let your horses loose on them without bridlesLiv. 40.40.5 (Lewis & Short)

See also attack.
